segments.text: LORD, remember David, and all his afflictions:
How he sware unto the LORD, and vowed unto the mighty God of Jacob;

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Surely I will not come into the tabernacle of my house, nor go up into my bed;

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: I will not give sleep to mine eyes, or slumber to mine eyelids,

segments.speaker: David
segments.text: Until I find out a place for the LORD, an habitation for the mighty God of Jacob.
Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.
We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.
Arise, O LORD, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.
Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.
For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.
The LORD hath sworn in truth unto David; he will not turn from it;

segments.speaker: the Lord
segments.text: Of the fruit of thy body will I set upon thy throne.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.
For the LORD hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

segments.speaker: God
segments.text: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.
